reviews.text: The lippie has the prettiest packaging of all lippies I’ve ever had, i got the Ribbon Pink shade but it doesn’t show up well on my lips unfortunately. It doesn’t dry out my lips at all and feels nice to apply, but on more saturated lips the lighter colors just.. don’t show up, they work like a transparent lippie. I wish it showed up more, but otherwise it’s not that bad!
reviews.zh: 呢支唇膏嘅包裝係我用過所有唇膏之中最靚嘅，我買咗 Ribbon Pink 色，但係可惜塗喺唇上唔係好顯色。佢完全唔會令唇乾，塗嗰陣感覺好舒服，但係如果唇色比較深，淺色就……唔係好見到，效果似透明唇膏。我希望佢顯色多啲，但其他方面都唔算差！

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Flower Knows Lip Jelly is absolutely adorable! The packaging is beautifully designed with so much attention to detail, making it feel extra special and luxurious. The formula feels incredibly comfortable on my lips, and the beautiful brown pigment is perfect for an everyday look. It gives my lips a smooth, glossy finish while keeping them hydrated without feeling sticky. It’s the perfect combination of cute packaging, gorgeous color, and a nourishing formula. I love it!
reviews.zh:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Flower Knows Lip Jelly 真係超可愛！包裝設計好精緻，好多細節，感覺特別高級。質地塗喺唇上好舒服，漂亮嘅啡色色素好啱日常化妝。佢令唇部有順滑、有光澤嘅效果，又保持水潤，唔會黏。可愛嘅包裝、靚嘅顏色同滋養嘅配方，三樣配合得好好。我好鍾意！

reviews.text: the packaging.....oh god.....i want to eat it it looks so so so so so so so yummy! but in all seriousness the packaging is really nice yes but its a hir or miss depending on what you like, the product is like margarine, its soft glossy and smells good if you like it then do get it if you dont then flowerknows have a very similar another cake shaped product and i'd suggest you look into that.
reviews.zh: 個包裝……哎呀……好想食佢，睇落好好好好好好好味呀！不過正經講，包裝真係好靚，但係啱唔啱就要睇你鍾唔鍾意。個質地似牛油（margarine），軟、有光澤，味道好聞。如果你鍾意就去買；如果唔鍾意，Flower Knows 有另一款形狀好似蛋糕嘅產品好相似，我建議你可以睇吓嗰款。

reviews.text:
it starts as a thin tinted gloss, but after about half an hour it develops into something a bit thicker on the lips. because of that, it has surprising longevity – it lasts super glossy for several hours, only having to reapply once after lunch..
the downside is the bulky packaging, that makes it a faff to carry around, and the applicator that is a bit thin and finicky. 
I’ve seen some people say it becomes transfer-proof (the colour stays on and only a bit of the gloss transfers), but for me there’s always colour transfer regardless. 
JE08 croissant is a gorgeous not too deep and not too warm brown, and it’s not so opaque to the point where it gets messy.
reviews.zh:
一開始係薄薄嘅有色唇彩，但係大約半個鐘之後會變得厚少少，塗喺唇上。因此佢持久力幾好出奇——好光澤可以維持幾個鐘，只係午飯後補一次就得。
缺點係包裝好大件，帶住走好麻煩，而且掃頭幾幼、好難用。
我見過有啲人話佢會防沾色（色澤留低，只會有少少唇彩轉移），但係我嘅情況無論點都會有沾色。
JE08 croissant 係一種好靚嘅啡色，唔會太深、又唔會太暖色，而且唔會不透明到搞到好污糟。

reviews.text: I bought this because Julia Adams was talking about this product as one of her faves from 2025. I also really enjoy this product- it’s so unusual but in a good way! The only downside is the packaging- I can’t take it with me because of the size and the little brush could do with an upgrade. But… I’m still keen to try some other colours.
reviews.zh: 我買呢款係因為 Julia Adams 話呢款係佢 2025 年嘅最愛之一。我都好鍾意呢款產品——好特別，但係係好嘅那種特別！唯一缺點係包裝——因為體積關係我冇辦法帶住出門，而且個細刷頭都可以升級。不過……我仲係好想試其他色。

reviews.text: This lip gloss is absolutely stunning! The formula feels soft and comfortable on the lips, not sticky at all. It gives a beautiful, glossy finish with a flattering color that enhances the natural lip tone. The scent is incredible — sweet but not overpowering. And the packaging? It completely stole my heart — so aesthetic and luxurious. Perfect for everyday wear or layering over lipstick. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a hydrating, shiny lip gloss with gorgeous packaging.
reviews.zh: 呢款唇彩真係超靚！質地塗喺唇上又軟又舒服，完全唔黏。效果亮澤漂亮，顏色襯托出唇部自然色調。味道好正——甜但唔會好濃。包裝呢？完全俘虜咗我嘅心——好有美感又奢華。日常用或者疊喺口紅上面都好啱。如果你想搵一支補水又亮晶晶、包裝又靚嘅唇彩，強烈推薦。

reviews.text: This lip jelly has adorable packaging and a very comfortable texture. It gives a glossy, jelly-like finish and a light tint that looks cute and fresh. The formula feels moisturizing and doesn’t dry out my lips during the day. I like wearing it for casual looks or reapplying it throughout the day. It’s both fun and practical.
reviews.zh: 呢款唇凍包裝好可愛，質地非常舒服。佢會帶嚟好似果凍咁嘅光澤效果，淡淡嘅色彩睇落可愛又清新。配方保濕，日間唔會令唇部乾燥。我鍾意用嚟配休閒造型，或者成日補一補。好玩又實用。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
